prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1217; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection. Our client was struck while proceeding through the intersection and has since been receiving medical treatment for injuries that are still being evaluated. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any other coverage that may apply. Please also confirm in writing that your insured has been notified of this claim.

We further ask that the insurer preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle inspection and repair records, telematics or event data, dash camera footage if any exists, and all communications with the insured or any third party. Please treat this request as a formal notice to preserve such materials until this matter is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt response.
